content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is an object storage service that allows digital creators to store and deliver their products without relying on traditional platforms like Gumroad or Payhip. This matters because it gives creators full control over their digital products, eliminating the need for intermediaries and their associated fees. With Cloudflare R2, creators can store their ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products, and deliver them instantly to customers upon payment confirmation.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of Cloudflare R2, combined with NOWPayments, works by storing digital products in a secure, decentralized manner. When a customer makes a payment in cryptocurrency, NOWPayments verifies the transaction and sends a confirmation signal to Cloudflare R2, which then delivers the product to the customer. This process happens automatically, without the need for manual intervention, ensuring a seamless experience for both creators and customers.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators who want to maintain full control over their products and customer relationships. It's ideal for those who sell digital products, such as ebooks, courses, templates, and software, and want to avoid the high fees charged by traditional platforms. With Cloudflare R2 and NOWPayments, creators can retain up to 99.5% of their revenue, compared to Gumroad's 10% fee, which can result in significant savings, especially for high-volume sellers.
Cloudflare R2 stores digital products securely and delivers them instantly upon payment confirmation.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this solution today, creators can start by setting up a Cloudflare R2 account and storing their digital products. They can then integrate NOWPayments with their Cloudflare R2 account, and set up a backend logic layer to handle payment verification and product delivery. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), creators can get instant access to all the necessary blueprints and templates to build, deploy, and scale their sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can use Cloudflare R2 for storage and delivery, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing. This solution allows creators to maintain full control over their products and customer relationships, while also avoiding high fees charged by traditional platforms. With a 0.5% fee, compared to Gumroad's 10% fee, creators can retain up to 99.5% of their revenue, resulting in significant savings.

For creators who want to take their digital commerce to the next level, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. This includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, which can be downloaded instantly from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. With this kit, creators can avoid platform fees and maintain full control over their products and customer relationships.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can follow these steps: set up a Cloudflare R2 account and store digital products, integrate NOWPayments with Cloudflare R2, set up a backend logic layer to handle payment verification and product delivery, configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email security, test the entire system end-to-end, and launch the stack.
